rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a group linked by family descent, rather than an ordinary household family.

example.english: Our clan has claimed for generations that we are descendants of that general.
example.traditional: 我哋家族幾代人都話係嗰位將軍嘅後人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaa1 zuk6 gei2 doi6 jan4 dou1 waa6 hai6 go2 wai6 zoeng1 gwan1 ge3 hau6 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a gaming clan whose members regularly play together on the same team.

example.english: Our clan is playing together again tonight.
example.traditional: 我哋個戰隊今晚又一齊打機。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 go3 zin3 deoi6 gam1 maan1 jau6 jat1 cai4 daa2 gei1

rows.note: Use this more formal term for a traditional hereditary clan such as a Scottish clan or a kinship-based political group.

example.english: A Scottish clan was formerly led by a chief.
example.traditional: 蘇格蘭氏族昔日由族長帶領。
example.jyutping: sou1 gaak3 laan4 si6 zuk6 sik1 jat6 jau4 zuk6 zoeng2 daai3 ling5
